note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 (gameplay classifications). The Church of Norway was the state church, with the King as its constitutional head until the constitutional amendment of 21 May 2012; it became a legally independent entity on 1 January 2017. Norway is outside the EU but trades with it through the European Economic Area, so free_trade is used. Conscription, energy, immigration and healthcare classifications are gameplay judgements (energy_mix reflects a hydropower electricity system alongside a large petroleum export sector).
